name: requirement-provenance-contradiction-guard
purpose: Prevent ranking and rejection errors when mirrors, snippets, or stale copies disagree about hard requirements, location, remote policy, language, schedule, or compensation.
provenanceOrder: verified recruiter statement tied to the exact role
rules: Store source URL, observedAt, source class, and exact normalized value for every critical requirement used in eligibility or ranking.
A lower-trust source may enrich a missing field but may not silently overwrite a conflicting higher-trust canonical value.
Any contradiction affecting location or remote eligibility sets locationEligibility to unknown until the exact role is reverified; distant onsite/hybrid evidence remains reject-distance.
Any contradiction affecting a hard qualification, language, schedule, driver/tachograph requirement, or employment form blocks APPLY-FIRST until resolved.
Compensation contradictions mark compensationComparable false until resolved; never average conflicting values.
Mirrors and snippets are discovery evidence only when canonical evidence is absent; never invent Facebook coverage or treat an inaccessible Facebook result as verified.
Resolution must preserve stable IDs, canonical dedupe, sourceTrust history, verifiedAt history, scoreConfidence, CRM/edit data, and fail-closed feed behavior.
